title: Adding Products to Your Store
description: Learn how to add products to your Matjrii store with detailed information, images, and variants.
content:
Adding Products to Your Store

Products are the foundation of your e-commerce store. This guide will walk you through adding products to your Matjrii store.

Step 1: Navigate to Products

From the dashboard, click on "Products" in the sidebar navigation.

Step 2: Click Add Product

Click the "Add Product" or "New Product" button.

Step 3: Fill in Basic Information

Enter the following required information:

  • Product Name: The name of your product
  • SKU: Stock Keeping Unit (unique identifier)
  • Description: Detailed product description (use the rich text editor)
  • Short Description: Brief summary of the product

Step 4: Set Pricing

Configure your product pricing:

  • Regular Price: Standard selling price
  • Sale Price: Discounted price (optional)
  • Compare at Price: Original price for showing discounts

Step 5: Manage Inventory

Set inventory options:

  • Stock Quantity: Number of items in stock
  • Track Inventory: Enable/disable stock tracking
  • Low Stock Alert: Get notified when stock is low
  • Stock Status: In stock, Out of stock, or Backorder

Step 6: Upload Product Images

Add product images:

  • Upload a featured image (main product image)
  • Add multiple images to the gallery
  • Images should be high quality and optimized for web

Step 7: Organize Product

Organize your product:

  • Category: Select or create a category
  • Tags: Add relevant tags for search and filtering
  • Product Status: Active, Inactive, or Draft

Step 8: Configure SEO

Optimize for search engines:

  • Meta title
  • Meta description
  • SEO-friendly URL slug

Step 9: Save Product

Click "Save" to add your product to the store. You can always edit it later.

Next Steps

After adding products, you may want to:

  • Organize products into categories
  • Manage inventory levels
